title: PointsKash Secures Capital Commitment After Beginning Rollout of Crypto ATMs
message_html: PointsKash Secures Capital Commitment After Beginning Rollout of Crypto ATMs ...
snippet: FinTech PointsKash has secured a strategic capital commitment of up to $100 million from Hawk Capital Advisors to support the national rollout of its FinTech, payments, loyalty rewards and digital commerce offerings, PointsKash said in a Wednesday (Aug. 12) press release.
